name: Forest
atmosphere: Towering ancient oaks filter pale emerald light through a canopy thick with moss and birdsong.
encounter_hooks: A moss-covered waystone hums beside a forked woodland trail.
Fresh claw marks scar the bark near an abandoned ranger camp.
Lanternlight flickers inside a hollow elder tree ahead.

name: Mountains
atmosphere: Jagged granite ridges rise above swirling mist, where cold winds carry the clang of distant stone.
encounter_hooks: A collapsed dwarven watchtower guards a narrow cliffside pass.
Carved runes along a rope bridge warn of an ancient guardian.
Echoing footsteps ring out from a windswept stone archway.

name: Coast
atmosphere: Salt spray crashes against basalt sea stacks beneath brooding grey skies and circling gulls.
encounter_hooks: A barnacle-crusted chest lies wedged in the ribs of a wrecked galley.
Tidewater reveals sunken stairs leading into a sea-carved shrine.
A lone lighthouse keeper signals frantically from the cliff edge.

name: Swamp
atmosphere: Twisted cypress roots rise from black mire, veiled in drifting marsh gas and pale bog-lights.
encounter_hooks: Rotting boardwalks wind toward a sunken bell tower in the fen.
Pale wisps drift above a circle of standing stones half-submerged in mud.
Bubbles break the murky water beside a mossy stone altar.

name: Cave
atmosphere: Damp limestone caverns glitter with damp stalactites and faint veins of luminescent crystal.
encounter_hooks: A subterranean river flows past a sealed bronze vault door.
Scattered mining tools surround a freshly breached chamber.
Cold drafts carry a metallic rattle from deeper within the tunnel.

name: Desert
atmosphere: Endless amber dunes shimmer under a relentless sun, hiding buried sandstone obelisks.
encounter_hooks: Wind-scoured steps descend into a half-buried sun temple.
An oasis dries to cracked clay around a weathered marble statue.
A caravan banner flutters beside a sandstone archway in the dunes.

name: Plains
atmosphere: Vast rolling grasslands ripple in the wind around crumbling watch-beacons and ancient barrows.
encounter_hooks: A stone barrow mound stands open beneath a circle of standing pillars.
Smoke rises from an abandoned courier post along the King's Road.
Broken shields mark the site of an old border skirmish.

name: Snowfields
atmosphere: Crisp white expanses stretch toward frozen peaks, hushed beneath drifting frost and aurora-lit clouds.
encounter_hooks: A frozen hearth still holds faint embers inside a ruined lodge.
Ice-rimmed monoliths form a silent ring across the glacier.
Deep tracks in the snow lead toward a half-buried iron gate.
